claims.text: The generalization ability of NCEL is verified by evaluating its performance on five different benchmarks, demonstrating consistent outperformance compared to baselines.
NCEL shows good generalization ability, particularly in challenging datasets, as evidenced by its performance improvements over local models in difficult cases.
The model's robustness and generalization ability are highlighted by its consistent performance across multiple datasets, indicating its effectiveness in diverse scenarios.
